scenarios.description: One bounded worker change passes fresh verification and independent audit.
scenarios.task_requirement: Add the deterministic result marker without changing protected paths.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The result marker exists and the fixture tests pass.

scenarios.description: A compile failure authorizes one exact correction and fresh final verification.
scenarios.task_requirement: Repair a deterministic compile failure within the admitted result file.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Compilation and the complete fixture test plan pass after one correction.

scenarios.description: A test failure authorizes one exact correction and fresh final verification.
scenarios.task_requirement: Repair a deterministic test failure without changing verification authority.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The original test fails once, the correction is bounded, and the fresh final test passes.

scenarios.description: A blocking audit finding is corrected, freshly verified, and independently re-audited.
scenarios.task_requirement: Correct the exact blocking audit finding and no unrelated source.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The finding is resolved only by fresh verification and a distinct clean audit.

scenarios.description: An ambiguous product choice becomes typed operator input without worker effects.
scenarios.task_requirement: Choose an unspecified result encoding.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: No encoding is selected without explicit operator authority.

scenarios.description: A missing task dependency refuses graph admission.
scenarios.task_requirement: Run only after the named prerequisite completes.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The task remains pending and no mutation lease is acquired when its dependency is missing.

scenarios.description: A dependency cycle refuses the complete graph before admission.
scenarios.task_requirement: Run only from an acyclic canonical task graph.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The cycle is typed and no run, workspace, sandbox, or lease effect begins.

scenarios.description: A worker attempt outside admitted mutation scope is denied.
scenarios.task_requirement: Change only result.txt.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: An attempted unrelated source change fails closed and cannot satisfy the criterion.

scenarios.description: A protected-path mutation is denied before acceptance.
scenarios.task_requirement: Change result.txt without touching harness authority.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Any .agent, .git, or .revolvr mutation fails closed.

scenarios.description: A materially identical failed correction strategy is denied.
scenarios.task_requirement: Correct the stable verification failure with new material evidence.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: An identical failure and strategy fingerprint stops as no progress.

scenarios.description: A successful worker claim with no material source change is refused.
scenarios.task_requirement: Create the admitted result marker.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: No-change worker output cannot advance the task or completion state.

scenarios.description: Changing verification authority is detected and cannot manufacture a pass.
scenarios.task_requirement: Implement the result without changing tests or goldens.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: A changed test authority hash yields a typed tamper stop.

scenarios.description: A source revision change after admission invalidates the run.
scenarios.task_requirement: Operate only on the scheduler-pinned source revision.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: A divergent managed source commit stops before verification or completion.

scenarios.description: Caller cancellation stops and removes the sandbox before releasing the lease.
scenarios.task_requirement: Stop bounded work when caller cancellation is observed.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Cancellation leaves no running sandbox and no changed original checkout.

scenarios.description: State-adjacent crash seams recover from exact durable authority.
scenarios.task_requirement: Recover exact state effects without duplicate completion or lease effects.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Exact replay completes once and divergent state evidence fails closed.

scenarios.description: Every external-effect seam is recovered through planned effect identity.
scenarios.task_requirement: Reconcile sandbox, worker, commit, and export effects by stable identity.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Exact replay is idempotent and any divergent external evidence stops unsafe.

scenarios.description: A stale index is explicit while exact and lexical context remains usable.
scenarios.task_requirement: Complete from exact source authority when the active retrieval index is stale.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Vector retrieval is marked stale, exact source remains first, and completion uses current source evidence.

scenarios.description: Missing embeddings degrade only the vector lane with no fallback representation.
scenarios.task_requirement: Complete from exact and lexical source when the local embedding service is absent.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The exact Qwen identity remains recorded, the vector lane is degraded, and no fabricated vector is used.

scenarios.description: The host classifies timeout as failure and removes the sandbox.
scenarios.task_requirement: Run only within the configured sandbox deadline.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: Timeout never passes verification and leaves no running container or lease.

scenarios.description: A dependency install request is denied by the none network profile.
scenarios.task_requirement: Install no dependency unless admitted network and supply-chain authority exists.
scenarios.acceptance_requirement: The install attempt is denied without public network traffic or policy downgrade.
